architectureDecision.reason: The approved scope is one static Astro landing page with no additional routes, shared application state, APIs or third-party integrations, persistence, authentication, background processing, migration, or new deployment boundary. Existing Astro/Vercel hosting is already established, so remaining component organization and validation behavior belong in planning rather than separate architecture documentation.
